messages:
kevin_support: Hey team — customer Acme reports function calls intermittently returning HTTP 400 with 'schema validation failed: "args.payment_token"' and high tail latency (~2.5s). Happened after yesterday's model rollout.

kevin_support: Paste of error from their logs:
```
{"error":"schema_validation","detail":"missing required field 'args.payment_token'","request_id":"req_01F..."}
```

kevin_support: They say it only fails for a subset of their prompts that include optional metadata and sometimes empty arrays.

sarah_eng: Can you add repro? sample prompt + exact payload they send? Also which model variant they're routed to?

kevin_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) POST /v1/chat with model=redwood-llm-1a
2) messages: system+user with user prompt including 'create_payment'
3) functions: [{name:\"payment.create\",...}]
4) sometimes args.payment_token is omitted by model and we get 400.

kevin_support: cURL they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-llm-1a","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"please create payment for order 123"}],"functions":[{"name":"payment.create","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"},"payment_token":{"type":"string"}},"required":["amount","payment_token"]}}]}'
```

maria_ops: I pulled the tenant logs — we show model responding with function call name but empty args in ~0.7% of requests. Latency spike aligns with cold shards and a fallback path we added last week.

maria_ops: snippet from our runtime logs:
```
2026-08-14T12:03:22Z INFO route=tenant-acme model=redwood-llm-1a call=function payment.create args={} latency=2487ms
```

jonathan_research: Noted. Our 'schema-sensitivity' eval suite (tool-calling golden set) started failing on the nightly CI after the new attention kernel. The test shows the model occasionally emits partial args (empty object) when sequence length crosses threshold.

ci-bot: CI failure: https://ci.redwood.ai/1234/builds/9876 — job: eval-schema-sensitivity — failing test: payment_create_missing_token

sarah_eng: Likely two issues: (1) model variant emits fewer tokens under some compaction optimization; function selection is fine but arg serialization gets truncated/omitted. (2) our strict server-side JSON schema validation returns 400 instead of trying to recover.

sarah_eng: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- Add server-side permissive fallback: if function name present but args empty, return 202 + run synthetic re-invoke with prompt hinting for args OR route to model-1a-stable.
- Add telemetry to capture raw model output for these cases.

kevin_support: Customer wants a short-term patch, they can tolerate slightly different flow if we keep them online.

sarah_eng: I'll put a small canary: relax validation for functions with 'payment.create' to allow missing payment_token and trigger a follow-up tool call to request missing fields. Patch PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/infra/patch/452

jonathan_research: For the long term we should add a schema robustness test to CI: send golden prompts with optional metadata arrays and assert function args present or fallback path executed. I'll add to eval harness.

maria_ops: Can someone own the rollback policy if canary spikes? I'll monitor.

kevin_support: @sarah_eng please post the canary window and rollback steps. @maria_ops will watch and @jonathan_research will update the eval.

sarah_eng: Canary plan: deploy relaxed validation to 10% of tenant-acme traffic for 30m, if tail latency > 3s or error rate >1% rollback. Rollback steps in PR description.

maria_ops: On it, setting alert: infra.alerts#schema-sensitivity to paged on error rate.

kevin_support: Thanks all. I'll update customer with repro steps + short-term workaround: set model pin to redwood-llm-1a-stable or enable server-side permissive fallback.

lisa_pm: Please add a note in the customer record and create a follow-up ticket to close the eval gap.

sarah_eng: PR merged to canary. will update when we see metrics. :thumbsup:

kevin_support: customer confirmed can accept the workaround for the next 24h.

ci-bot: eval-schema-sensitivity rerun queued (build 9877).

jonathan_research: Thanks. If CI passes we can bake the test into nightly and block model upgrades until coverage is green.

kevin_support: Closing loop: will post final status here after canary.
